warning: TEST-ONLY xpubs: BIP32 test vector 1 and synthetic EdDSA keys from fixed labels. Never send funds to these addresses.
regeneration: Generated by Vaultody's vault service from its own derivation code, which is not public. Deterministic: a rerun writes the same bytes.
source: Every address is what Vaultody's vault service returns: its deposit-address derivation for change false, and its change-address derivation for change true, with the version of its xpub library that the service pins.

derivation.path: m/{accountIndex}/{change ? 1 : 0}/{addressIndex}, below the stored xpub, no hardened step. accountIndex and addressIndex are 0..2147483647.
derivation.xpub: base58check, 78 bytes: version(4) depth(1) parentFingerprint(4) childNumber(4) chainCode(32) key(33). Only chainCode and key are used: the service rewrites the version to 0488b21e, and depth, parent fingerprint and child number play no part. key is 02/03 + x for ECDSA and 00 + the 32-byte Ed25519 public key for EdDSA.
derivation.ECDSA: BIP32 public child derivation (CKDpub, hdkey) at each of the three levels. If a level is invalid (IL >= n or the point at infinity), hdkey derives index + 1 at that level instead, and at index 2147483647 that fails. No vector here can reach this (probability about 2^-127).
derivation.EDDSA: At each level, with key = the 32-byte public key and chainCode = 32 bytes, i = the level index as 4 bytes LITTLE-endian: k = HMAC-SHA256(chainCode, 0x02 || key || i) read as a BIG-endian 256-bit integer; child key = encode(k * decode(key)) on ed25519; child chainCode = HMAC-SHA256(chainCode, 0x03 || key || i). k is not reduced mod l; that is the same point for any key in the prime-order subgroup, which every key here and every MPC key is. There is no skip rule.
derivation.algorithm: The service picks the vault key whose algorithm equals the chain's default algorithm (chains.*.algorithm).

notes: change is a boolean, as on the wire; the path element is 1 when it is true.
addressFormat is the value the service stores with the address and hands to the lib, upper case; addressFormatWire is its lower-case API form. Compare formats case-insensitively.

chains.*.defaultAddressFormat is the format the service derives when the request names none. No request reads a format today, so every new address uses it; the other formats can only be on older addresses.
For zcash, xrp, tron, solana and the EVM chains the lib ignores the format and only echoes it; each has one format.
xrp, tron, solana and EVM addresses do not depend on the network; the UTXO chains do (chains.*.networks lists the prefixes from the lib).
chains.*.networks.*.vaultType: MAIN for mainnet, TEST for every other network (the service refuses any other pairing).
publicKey is the derived child key as the service stores it: 33-byte compressed for ECDSA, 32 bytes for EdDSA.
In the EdDSA code an index of 2^32 or more wraps to index mod 2^32 instead of failing. The service never passes one; a helper must refuse anything above 2147483647.
rejected lists inputs the service refuses or cannot derive. A helper must not report any of them as verified.

The service refuses P2SH on bitcoin-cash, dogecoin and dash and P2SH-CASH on bitcoin-cash (INVALID_DATA), because on chains without SegWit the P2SH-wrapped P2WPKH script can be spent by anyone. Those combinations have no cases; each is in rejected, one entry per network. A helper given such a format must refuse it as unsupported. P2SH on bitcoin and litecoin stays valid.

Coverage: every chain, network and format. The depth-0 xpub of the chain's algorithm gets m/0/0/0, m/1/1/1, m/7/0/5, m/0/1/2147483647; every other xpub gets m/7/1/5. The full grid (accounts 0, 1, 7 x change 0, 1 x indexes 0, 1, 5, 2147483647) replaces those with the depth-0 xpub on one mainnet chain per address encoding (bitcoin/mainnet/P2PKH, bitcoin/mainnet/P2SH, bitcoin/mainnet/P2WPKH, bitcoin-cash/mainnet/P2PKH-CASH, zcash/mainnet/P2PKH, xrp/mainnet/CLASSIC, tron/mainnet/BASE58, ethereum/mainnet/STANDARD, solana/mainnet/BASE58), and with every xpub on bitcoin/mainnet/P2WPKH and solana/mainnet/BASE58.

encodings.P2PKH: base58check(pubKeyHash || hash160(compressed child key)); pubKeyHash is 1 byte, except zcash where it is 2 bytes
encodings.P2SH: base58check(scriptHash || hash160(0x00 0x14 || hash160(compressed child key))): P2SH-wrapped P2WPKH; derived on bitcoin and litecoin, refused by the service on bitcoin-cash, dogecoin and dash (no cases there)
encodings.P2WPKH: bech32 (BIP173, witness version 0) with hrp = bech32 and program = hash160(compressed child key)
encodings.P2PKH-CASH: CashAddr, type P2KH, of hash160(compressed child key); prefix bitcoincash on mainnet and bchtest on testnet
encodings.P2SH-CASH: CashAddr, type P2SH, of the same script hash as P2SH (the P2SH-wrapped P2WPKH script); the service refuses it on bitcoin-cash, so there are no cases and it only appears in rejected
encodings.CLASSIC: xrp: base58check with the ripple alphabet of 0x00 || hash160(compressed child key); the same address on every network
encodings.BASE58: tron: base58check(versionPrefix 0x41 || last 20 bytes of keccak256(uncompressed child key without its 0x04 byte)). solana: plain base58 (bitcoin alphabet, no checksum) of the 32-byte EdDSA child key
encodings.STANDARD: "0x" + lowercase hex (no EIP-55 checksum) of the last 20 bytes of keccak256(uncompressed child key without its 0x04 byte); the same address on every EVM chain and network

xpubs.name: ecdsa-bip32-tv1-m0h
xpubs.description: BIP32 test vector 1, chain m/0H: depth 1, nonzero parent fingerprint, hardened child number, like the depth-1 xpubs some vaults store.

xpubs.name: ecdsa-bip32-tv1-master-tpub
xpubs.description: The depth-0 key with tpub version bytes. It derives exactly the addresses of ecdsa-bip32-tv1-master: the version bytes are ignored.

xpubs.name: eddsa-test-depth0
xpubs.description: Synthetic EdDSA key at depth 0 (TEST-ONLY seed).

xpubs.name: eddsa-test-depth1
xpubs.description: Synthetic EdDSA key at depth 1 with a nonzero parent fingerprint and a hardened child number (TEST-ONLY seed).
